title: Kiritani Haruka — MORE MORE HOUSE Surprise〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everybody ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, ready!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She should be here very soon...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for being so late!
My previous appointment dragged on a bit and...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: H-Huh? Is nobody here?

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy Valentine's Day, Saito!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Our surprise went off without a hitch!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Umm... I-I'm sorry, but I still don't really know what's going on here...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Today's Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's all about showing your appreciation for others, so we want you to know just how grateful we are to you, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Naturally, we've even prepared gifts.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
What...?! Gifts...?!
F-For me? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! They're for you to have!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, chocolates...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
These spoon chocolates are from me.
I even wrote a message using them to show just how much we appreciate you!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Wow, they all have letters on them! And they spell out, “THANK YOU”.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And I love how sparkly the decorations around the letters are. I think they're very cute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have tea leaves for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're chamomile and Earl Grey, which are supposed to be very relaxing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know work can get tough sometimes, so I hope this tea helps you take your mind off things.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll use this tea to keep doing my best for all of you...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go next.
I have a book cover for you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Wow... Oh, is this embroidered?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
There's a big tree...
With very carefully decorated leaves. It's beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I went with a big tree because of how you support us and help keep us all standing.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku... Does that mean you embroidered this yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I did.
I wanted you to know just how much you mean to us.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Wh-What...?! Y-You made this just for me?! I don't know what to say! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Last but not least, my gift.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mine probably didn't turn out quite as well since it was my first time trying this... But I embroidered a pen case for you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Wait, Haruka, you too?
Did you embroider these flowers?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, they're violets.
They're meant to symbolize just how much we need you.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
What?! Th-That's so beautiful!
And you're selling yourself short...! I think these are very cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad that you like my gift.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we really can't thank you enough, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I mean, you agreed to become our manager despite us not belonging to an agency.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're able to do what we do because of you, Saito. So, we'll be counting on you moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Thank you all so very much for your wonderful gifts! I'm going to make these my new family heirlooms...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Heirlooms?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm not sure tea and chocolates work well as heirlooms.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I can't believe this is really happening. I must be dreaming...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, I need to call my mom!
Would you all mind if I did that right now?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're acting just like Minori after Haruka winked at her during a concert.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why do you feel like calling your mom all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To say, “Thank you for bringing me into this world!” Because Saito wouldn't be here to enjoy this day if she hadn't!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori with her deep understanding of fans strikes again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad she likes our gifts so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Again, Saito, we look forward to our continued partnership.

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: We look forward to our continued partnership!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: O-Of course! Thank you all very much!
